title: [negative result] Certify the GL2 floor for three G20 boundary exchanges
body:
General binary pair bases cannot shorten three isolated four-bank exchanges in exact PR5840 below six charged XORs each. This fixes 18 of the current 38 XORs per boundary side when synthesis remains component-local. No kappa improvement or global boundary optimum is claimed.

The new source-specific certificate covers all 36 independent GL2(F2) pair bases, all 20,160 invertible four-by-four binary maps and all 241,920 directed unit-XOR edges. Exact minimum histogram: `6:2, 7:8, 8:24, 9:2`. Complete potentials, attaining words and a written finite argument are included. A separate implementation imports no producer/predecessor code: it enumerates full 16-input truth tables and independent column-image domains, then checks every distance, all candidate forward/inverse maps and both actual source words. Ten producer and three separate semantic/integrity controls reject.

Reproduce with Python 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-gl2-tail-floor
```

Expected in normal and optimized modes: `PASS_G20_GL2_TAIL_FLOOR`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_G20_GL2_TRUTH_TABLES`, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Evidence regeneration is deterministic; exact-byte, ancestry, patch and Git-free export checks are recorded in the handoff.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a` (priority 8). Contribution: `d16bbda22dbd9392fed3c947fb2bd518ed3b43e6`. Source: PR5840 head `6a043d0fc0199ee5b24c61f883f1943eaf6424be`, controller blob `73fa9f40a032f11dabf357eba69066fcf9bf0a02`, retained as exact data with SHA256 and original notice. No unmerged executable, network or pending commit is needed for replay. Only `research/g20-gl2-tail-floor/` is added.

OS seed 14 assigned the bit-supplier track. CLAIM.md records three narrow candidates, the optimistic two-boundary budget, bounded overlap checks and completed coverage. No pinned sprint issue existed; the claim/result is local. This intentionally changed scope answers part of PR5840's GL2 handoff and does not satisfy the original changed-recursive-profile gate.

Limits: four arbitrary registers per component, all 12 directed unit-XORs, no extra workspace or cross-component gates. The remaining 18-register component, cross-component synthesis, nonbinary bases and different tariffs remain open. Native phases, the physical core/caller, ROW/tape/rounding, compiler and analytic contracts are inherited rather than freshly replayed. The selected kappa stays 0.00310045 and all five framework assumptions remain. This finite certificate is not a formalization of the multiplication theorem or independent human acceptance; hosted CI is separate.

Credit Ali Romman for PR5840's mechanism/controller and PR5834, PR5807/5828, PR5708/5671, ai-nanachi PR5512, Dugongue and the retained native/controller/compiler lineage. PR5793's generic XOR synthesis and six-XOR reversal are prior work; neither is recounted as new. New work binds the actual G20 components and certifies all 36 basis variants with two representations.

Prepared for **Charan / theon199 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, code, writing and verification. No subagents or independent human review. Apache-2.0; predecessor notice retained.
